description: Source code for F1AP Positioning Information Exchange Procedure, including conversion functions between common and ASN.1 types, and procedure implementation for handling positioning info requests and responses within a 3GPP-based system.

classes.name: f1ap_positioning_information_exchange_procedure
classes.description: Handles the positioning information exchange procedure, including sending requests, awaiting responses, and converting ASN.1 messages.

methods.name: fill_asn1_positioning_information_request
methods.description: Converts a common positioning information request into ASN.1 format.

methods.name: fill_positioning_information_response
methods.description: Converts ASN.1 positioning info response into common format.

methods.name: fill_positioning_information_failure
methods.description: Converts ASN.1 positioning info failure into common format.

methods.name: ref_sig_to_asn1
methods.description: Converts spatial relation reference signals to ASN.1 format.
